latest.notes: The log now keeps the whole day. Logs shows it as scheduled from midnight on, with what has aired marked; On Air shows what's left to play, dropping each element as it finishes — one log, two views of it. Elements dropped at the top of the hour are marked and written to Errors and Skips rather than deleted, so the Logs screen shows the day as it was built and always agrees with the Played report. Settings > General's 'Keep aired items in the log' switch is gone; it is simply how the log works.
